> Review a dependency update

1. Identify production, development, CI, or build impact.
2. Check changelog, supported runtime, advisories, and breaking changes.
3. Run dependency review and the complete validation contract.
4. Inspect lockfile, generated artifacts, and bundle changes.
5. Keep major updates manual unless migration and rollback are proven.
